description: Form 8582-CR Part II: a $3,000 credit from rental real estate with active participation, no passive income, wages $80,000. Line 7 = 3,000; line 10 modified AGI 80,000; line 12 = min(25,000, 50% x 70,000) = 25,000; line 14 = 25,000 (Form 8582 line 9 is zero); line 15 = tax on 64,250 (row midpoint 64,275: $9,055) less tax on 39,250 (row midpoint 39,275: $4,475) = $4,580; line 16 = min(3,000, 4,580) = $3,000 allowed.
